## 🚀 Hackathon Pull Request

### 📌 Summary of Changes
- Briefly describe what was added, modified, or resolved in this PR.

### 🎯 Related Issue / Task
- Closes #[issue-number] or relates to [feature-name]

### 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] ✨ New Feature (agent capability, UI component, endpoint)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix
- [ ] ⚡ Performance Optimization
- [ ] 📝 Documentation Update
- [ ] 🔧 Configuration / Build setup

### ✅ Hackathon Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles/runs locally without crashing
- [ ] Environment variables documented in `.env.example` if any new ones were added
- [ ] No secret keys or credentials committed
- [ ] Tested on feature branch before merging into `main`
